investor_message_milestone_1: Hi there, Aapse milke achha laga, mera naam Rosy hai aur main Devhives se aapki nayi advisor hoon. Kya aapne apni website ke neeche milestones notice kiye? Har baar jab aap ek milestone complete karenge, turant ek payment mil jayegi. Shuruaat ek office se karo. Hum recommend karte hain ki aap map ke top left corner wali Small Building rent karein.
investor_message_milestone_4: Wow! Aapka naya Landing Page pakka logon ko {productName} ke liye excited kar dega! Bas thodi marketing chahiye taaki kuch traffic aaye. Apni website pe jao aur Marketing Tab select karo. Wahan se ek Email Campaign banao aur registered users ko badhte hue dekho. Daily budget badhane se daro mat.
investor_message_milestone_satisfaction: Great work, aapka pehla real feature! Kya aapne features tab ke top left corner mein smiley notice kiya? Ye dikhata hai ki aapke users kitne satisfied hain. Abhi wo zyada khush nahi hain kyunki aapka naya feature bahut low level ka hai. Satisfaction high rakhna bahut important hai. Agar ye low ho gaya, toh users aapki website chhodna shuru kar denge. Apne naye feature ka level badhakar website ki satisfaction badhao. Required modules banane ke liye aapko ek Lead Developer hire karna hoga.
investor_message_milestone_more_users: Beautiful! Features upgrade karte waqt (potential users badhane ke liye) hamesha features ke levels balance rakhne ki koshish karo, taaki users khush rahein. Humein aur users chahiye! Email Campaigns chalate raho. Dhyan rakho ki aapke potential users registered users se zyada hon. Feature levels upgrade karke potential users badhao.
investor_message_milestone_8: Itne saare users! Maanna padega, yahan {investorName} mein log aapki success pe bet lagane lage hain, hum bahut impressed hain! Ab servers ki baat karte hain. Jaise-jaise aap features add ya upgrade karoge, aur zyada CU (Compute Units) chahiye honge. Shuruaat ek SysAdmin hire karke karo, bilkul waise hi jaise aapne Developer aur Designer ke saath kiya tha. Phir apni website select karke aur Hosting Tab pe click karke ek Mini Cloud Server add karo. Required components produce karne ke liye apne SysAdmin ko use karo.
investor_message_milestone_first_income: Ye hui na baat. Server load pe nazar rakhna yaad rakho. Agar ye 100% se upar gaya toh aap users khone lagoge. Ab dheere-dheere kuch income generate karne pe focus karna chahiye. Shuruaat Text Ads feature research karke kisi khaali feature slot mein add karne se karo. Phir ek Sales Executive hire karo aur apna pehla ad contract negotiate karo.
investor_message_milestone_more_workstat: Good job! Apni income steady rakhna aur jin deals mein negotiation chahiye unhe respond karna yaad rakho. Kya aapne notice kiya ki hamara staff ek dusre ke paas-paas baithne laga hai? Developers ko ye bilkul pasand nahi! Behtar hoga ki hum bada office le lein. City Map pe jao aur ek bada office rent karo.
investor_message_milestone_valuation: Good choice! Agle milestone ke liye hum bas chahte hain ki aap apni website pe kaam karo. Feature levels upgrade karte raho aur marketing campaigns chalate raho. Naye employees hire karne se daro mat. Aapki current valuation website ke Stats tab mein dikh jayegi. Ab jao aur target valuation tak pahuncho.
investor_message_milestone_more_users_2: Ek aur milestone badhiya se complete! Chalo, ab hamari marketing ko improve karne pe dhyan dena hoga. Shuruaat ek marketer hire karke karo. Uske baad apna pehla Text Ads campaign banao. Insight feature pe ek nazar zaroor daalna. Jab koi campaign apni 10% audience tak pahunch jaata hai, tab aapko aur insight mil sakti hai. Dekhna worth it hai! Target registered users tak pahuncho.
investor_message_milestone_12: {productName} ki zabardast growth ke liye congratulations. Ab frameworks ki baat karni hai. Abhi aap ek free framework use kar rahe ho jo future mein humein chahiye wale feature levels handle hi nahi kar payega. Framework upgrade karne ke liye apni website ke Features Tab ke top right corner mein Upgrade button pe click karo.
investor_message_milestone_13: Great choice! Naye framework se aap kaafi zyada high feature levels tak pahunch sakte ho. Ab phir se servers ki baat karne ka time hai. Ab tak hum "cloud servers" use kar rahe the, jo basically kisi aur ka server hai jo hum rent pe lete hain. Humein lagta hai ki {productName} ke liye apne servers in-house laana achha idea hai. Shuruaat City Map pe jaakar karo aur servers host karne ke liye suitable ek building rent karo.
investor_message_milestone_14: Aapki brand new hosting facility mein welcome! Yahan aap mehenge cloud servers rent karne ki jagah apne khud ke servers kharid aur setup kar sakte ho. Shuruaat ek rack kharid ke place karne se karo. Isi mein hum apne servers install karenge. Apne naye rack pe click karo aur 1 web server, 1 database server aur 1 cache server install karo. Aakhir mein, dhyan rakho ki saare servers configured hon, bas server pe click karo aur phir Configure button dabao. Target Produced CU tak pahuncho.
investor_message_milestone_15: Great! Hamare SysAdmins bol rahe hain ki naye servers ekdum optimally chal rahe hain. Aapka agla milestone bada hai. Abhi hum har month paisa loss kar rahe hain. Hum chahte hain ki aap game palat do aur profit kamao. Features introduce aur improve karte raho, marketing campaigns chalate raho aur apna naya hosting center expand karo. Shayad aur Sales Executives hire karna achha idea hoga, taaki aapke ad schedule mein koi gap na rahe. Main aapse tab baat karungi jab company achha khaasa paisa kamane lagegi.
investor_message_milestone_more_users_3: Oh my gosh, congratulations! {productName} officially profit kama rahi hai! Maine abhi baaki investors se baat ki aur hum sabko lagta hai ki ab next level pe jaane ka time hai! Marketing campaigns chalao, features upgrade karo aur aur servers install karo. Apni life easy banane ke liye Managers hire karna mat bhoolna. Target registered users tak pahuncho.
investor_message_milestone_higher_cpm: Aap bahut fast progress kar rahe ho, well done! Main abhi conference room se nikli hoon aur board ko lagta hai ki aap aur bhi zyada paisa kama sakte ho! Agar abhi tak nahi kiya, toh Banner Ads ya Video Ads jaisa zyada paisa dene wala revenue feature implement karo. Satisfaction pe nazar rakhna yaad rakho, hum nahi chahte ki ye 50% se neeche jaaye! Kuch naye deals negotiate karo aur target website income tak pahuncho.
investor_message_milestone_16: Investors super excited hain! Pichli baar jab unse baat hui, wo celebrate karne apne private jets mein Marbella ja rahe the. Aap ab officially successful ho! Celebration ke baad aapko ek naye goal pe focus karna chahiye: ek competitor ko acquire karna. Isme na sirf bahut saara paisa lagega, balki merge se aane wale saare naye users ko handle karne ke liye hamara data center bhi scale karna padega. Capital build karte raho jab tak aap ek competitor acquire karne layak na ho jao.

backstory_designer_description: Designer ke background ke saath aap apni nayi website banane ke liye graphical components produce karne mein help kar sakte ho.
backstory_developer_description: Developer ke background ke saath aap apni nayi website banane ke liye technical components produce karne mein help kar sakte ho.
backstory_manager_description: Manager ke background ke saath aap apne employees se apne production plans follow karwa sakte ho aur unhe speed bonus de sakte ho.

help_ad_contracts_intro:
Zyada tar websites par income ka main source ad contracts hi hote hain. Simple bhasha mein, aap apni website mein add kiye gaye Revenue Features ke through ad spaces bechoge.

Contracts dhoondhna

Aisa customer dhoondhne ke liye jo aapki website par advertise karna chahe, aapko ek Sales Executive hire karna padega.

Har potential customer ko "Lead" kehte hain. Leads ki maximum sankhya Sales Executive ke level se limited hoti hai.

Negotiation

Employees hire karne ki tarah hi, best price paane ke liye aapko ad contracts negotiate karne padenge.
help_ad_contracts_properties_intro: Negotiate karne ke liye aapko kuch properties samajhni padengi:
help_ad_contracts_properties_table:
Guaranteed Impressions Aap guarantee karte ho ki ad din mein kitni baar dikhega. Aapko kabhi bhi pichle din se zyada impressions guarantee nahi karne chahiye. Zyada impressions = zyada price/CPM.
Contract Length Contract expire hone se pehle kitne din chalega. Contract ko time se pehle cancel karne par aapko cancellation fee deni padegi. Lambe contracts = zyada price/CPM.
Offer Negotiation se pehle ka current CPM (har 1000 impressions ka price), guaranteed impressions aur contract length ke basis par.
Penalty Fee Agar aap guaranteed impressions deliver nahi kar paaye toh CPM ka kitna percentage aapko bharna padega.
Daily Payment Contract active rehne tak aapko har din milne wali payment.
help_ad_contracts_timeslots_description: Din ko multiple time slots mein divide karke aap ek hi Ads Feature par multiple contracts chala sakte ho.
help_controlling_time_intro: Game window ke ekdum upar wale arrow buttons par click karke aap time ki speed control kar sakte ho.
help_controlling_time_toggle: Pause button ko toggle kar sakte ho, jisse aap aasani se last select ki hui play speed par wapas aa sakte ho.
help_citymap_intro: Citymap se aapko Startup Company ki saari buildings ka access milta hai. Buildings do type ki hoti hain: Office aur Hosting.
help_citymap_description: Saari buildings rent par hain aur unka rent roz dena padta hai. Nayi building mein shift hote waqt ek upfront payment bhi deni padti hai.
help_citymap_building_types_office_descr:
Office buildings mein aapke saare employees hote hain. Saara kaam yahin hota hai.

Har office building mein ek limit hoti hai ki kitne workstations (employees) aa sakte hain. Kuch buildings mein multiple floors hote hain.
help_citymap_building_types_hosting_desc:
Hosting buildings mein aapke saare racks aur servers hote hain. Dedicated hosting buildings tabhi kaam ki hain jab aap virtual servers ki maximum limit tak pahunch chuke ho.

Hosting building mein aap kitne bhi devices install kar sakte ho, bas physical jagah ki limit hai. Har building ek initial temperature ke saath aati hai. Temperature jitna kam, aapke servers ko utni kam cooling chahiye.
help_purchase_intro: Jab bhi aap kisi building mein ho, aap Purchase Menu se items khareed sakte ho.
help_purchase_description: Koi bhi item khareedne se pehle use Research Menu se research karna padta hai. Kaun se items milenge, yeh aapki select ki hui building ke type (office ya hosting) par depend karta hai.
help_purchase_adding_items_description:
1. Purchase Menu se ek item select karo.

2. ya R dabakar item ko rotate karo.

3. dabakar location confirm karo.
help_purchase_moving_items_description:
1. Mouse ko item ke upar hover karo aur dabao.

2. Mouse ko nayi location par le jao aur dabakar confirm karo.
help_purchase_removing_items_description:
1. Mouse ko item ke upar hover karo aur dabao.

2. DELETE dabakar ya bottom left corner mein Archive Icon par click karke item ko archive karo.

Items remove karne se woh delete nahi hote. Woh bas aapki item inventory mein chale jaate hain, aur aap unhe bina kisi charge ke dobara place kar sakte ho.
help_purchase_tip: Tip: Item place karte waqt <key>SHIFT</key> dabaye rakhoge toh ek hi item ki multiple copies place kar sakte ho.
help_researching_intro: Startup Company mein sab kuch Research Menu se unlock karna padta hai. Item unlock hote hi woh relevant jagah turant available ho jayega.
help_researching_description: Har unlockable ko unlock karne ke liye kuch Research Points kharch karne padte hain. Researchers hire karke aap Research Points produce kar sakte ho.
help_researching_tip: Tip: Sab kuch unlock hone ke baad Researchers ki koi zaroorat nahi rehti, aap bindaas unhe fire kar sakte ho.
help_recruitment_intro: Aap apne Chief Executive Officer ya kisi Recruiter ke through employees recruit aur hire kar sakte ho.
help_recruitment_headhunting_description:
Employees recruit karna do steps mein hota hai. Pehle, aap potential candidates ko headhunt karte ho. Recruiters sirf apne hi level ke employees headhunt kar sakte hain.

Aap har candidate ki expected salary research kar sakte ho. Isse aapko accha estimate mil jata hai ki employee kitni salary expect karta hai. Doosra, aap employee ki demands bhi research kar sakte ho. Isse aap aise candidates avoid kar sakte ho jo aapke current office aur enabled benefits mein fit nahi hote.

In mein se koi bhi detail research karne se candidate ko headhunt karne mein zyada time lagega.

Headhunt kiye gaye candidates sirf 96 ghante tak available rahenge.
help_recruitment_negotiation_description: Candidates ke saath negotiate karte waqt aap chaho toh unhe signing bonus offer kar sakte ho. Ek baar ke upfront bonus ke badle kam monthly salary lock karne ka yeh effective tareeka hai.
help_recruitment_instant_hire_descriptio:
Expert Recruiters kisi candidate ko fixed salary par turant hire kar sakte hain. Isse aap lamba negotiation process skip kar sakte ho.

"Instantly Hire" enable karne ke liye aapka Recruiter Expert level ka hona chahiye aur salary aur demands dono research honi chahiye.
help_features_intro:
Startup Company mein website features do type ke hote hain: Base Features & Revenue Features. Har feature aapki website par ek slot leta hai. Aapke paas utne hi slots hain jitne aapka current framework support karta hai.

Saare features Research Menu se research karne padte hain.
help_features_base_features_description:
Base Features aapki website ki User Capacity badhate hain. Kitni capacity badhegi, yeh feature ke level par depend karta hai. Upgrade button dabakar aap level upgrade kar sakte ho. Har level ke liye kuch components ya modules chahiye.

Har baar feature upgrade karne par woh zyada Compute Units consume karega aur aapki website ka response time badhega. Isse counter karne ke liye aap feature ki efficiency improve kar sakte ho. Efficiency 100% tak ja sakti hai aur yeh response time aur consumed compute units dono kam karti hai.
help_features_revenue_features_descripti:
Revenue Features, Base Features ke ulat, koi compute units (CU) nahi lete aur website ka response time nahi badhate. Iski jagah, inse aap apni website se income generate kar sakte ho.

Income ke do sources hain: Ads & Subscriptions. Dono website satisfaction kam karte hain. Number jitna kam, end-users feature se utne zyada naakhush.

Framework Limitations

Aapka current framework limit karta hai ki aapke features kitne high level tak ja sakte hain aur aap kitne features add kar sakte ho. Jab saare feature slots bhar jayein aur sab ka maximum level ho jaye, tab aap framework upgrade kar sakte ho.
help_frameworks_intro:
Framework aapki website ka structure hai. Saare features aapke frameworks ke upar bane hote hain.

Har website Basic Framework se start hoti hai. Phir Research Menu se research karne ke baad aap kai saare frameworks mein se kisi par bhi upgrade kar sakte ho.

Naye frameworks aapka overall compute unit (CU) consumption kam karte hain, feature slots badhate hain aur maximum feature level badhate hain.
help_frameworks_upgrade_description:
Naye framework par upgrade karne ke liye do cheezein chahiye:

  • Saare feature slots bhare hon.
  • Saare base features maximum level tak upgrade hon.

Yeh requirements poori hote hi aap framework upgrade kar paoge. Har framework ke saath ek upfront payment hoti hai.
help_satisfaction_intro:
Website ki satisfaction growth aur success ka bahut important hissa hai.

Website ki satisfaction rating teen cheezon se decide hoti hai:

  • Base features ki satisfaction
  • Kitne revenue features use ho rahe hain
  • Support satisfaction
help_satisfaction_more_details: Smiley par hover karke aap satisfaction ki aur details dekh sakte ho.
help_satisfaction_effect_description:
Agar aapki website ki satisfaction 50% se neeche gayi, toh aap registered users khone lagoge.

Marketing campaigns aur organic growth kitne effective honge, yeh aapki satisfaction rating par depend karta hai. Satisfaction jitni zyada, naye users laana utna aasaan.
help_hosting_intro: Apni website online rakhne ke liye aapko hosting ka dhyaan rakhna padega. Do cheezon par nazar rakho: Server Load aur Response Time.
help_hosting_server_load_description: Server load kabhi 100% se upar nahi jana chahiye. Agar gaya, toh aapki website ka response time badhne lagega. Server load jaldi kam karne ke liye compute units (CU) badhao, yaani aur servers install karo.
help_hosting_response_time_description: Agar response time bahut zyada ho jaye aur aapki website Unstable ya Critical mein chali jaye, toh matlab aapko apne website features ki efficiency improve karni chahiye.
help_hosting_servers_description:
Har nayi website Virtual Servers se start hoti hai. Inse aap daily basis par servers rent kar sakte ho.

Servers compute units (CU) produce karte hain. Website smoothly chale, iske liye ensure karo ki aap website ki zaroorat se zyada CU produce kar rahe ho.

Jaise-jaise aapki website badi hoti hai, aap Virtual Servers aur use nahi kar paoge aur aapko ek Hosting Building rent karke apne khud ke servers setup karne padenge.
help_hosting_types_virtual_servers_descr:
Koi initial investment nahi chahiye. Fast aur easy. Servers limited number mein available hain.

Price per CU zyada mehenga hai.
help_hosting_types_hosting_building_desc:
Upfront cost bahut zyada hai kyunki aapko hosting building rent karni padti hai, plus racks aur servers khareed kar setup karne padte hain.

Price per CU sasta hai.
help_hosting_types_tip: Tip: Website ki zaroorat poori karne ke liye Virtual Servers aur Hosting Buildings saath-saath chal sakte hain.
help_hosting_configuration_description:
Har server ko kuch components chahiye. Components produce karne ke liye aapko ek SysAdmin chahiye.

Servers configure karne mein jo components lag gaye, woh wapas nahi milte.
help_marketing_intro:
Website par naya traffic laane ke liye aap marketing campaign use kar sakte ho.

Marketing campaigns 6 type ke hote hain. Unme farak sirf cost aur conversion rate ka hai.

Email campaigns ko chhodkar saare campaigns ko marketing components chahiye. Components produce karne ke liye aapko ek Marketer chahiye.
help_marketing_conversionrate_descriptio:
Marketing campaign chalate waqt aap apni website ke ads limited logon ko dikhaoge. Conversion rate batata hai ki in mein se kitne log actually aapke ad par click karke aapki website ke visitor bante hain.

High conversion rate ka matlab hai zyada log aapke ad par click karte hain, aur aapka paisa un logon ko ads dikhane mein waste nahi hota jinhe usme interest hi nahi.
help_marketing_reach_description: Reach batata hai ki kitne log potentially aapka ad dekh sakte hain. Higher level features jinka kaafi time se promotion nahi hua, unki reach sabse zyada hogi.
help_marketing_cpm_description: CPM batata hai ki apna ad 1000 logon ko dikhane ke liye aap kitna pay karte ho. Zyada CPM dena aksar worth it hota hai, bas conversion rate bhi utna hi zyada hona chahiye.
help_marketing_targeting_description:
Conversion rate improve karne ke liye aap targeting use kar sakte ho. Targeting limit karne ka matlab hai apne ads sirf ek specific audience/type ke logon ko dikhana.

Target match hai ya nahi, yeh jaanne ke liye aapko campaign research karna padega.
help_marketing_targeting_example: Upar wale example mein aap dekhoge ki Food, Sports aur Age 26-50 accha match tha. Iske ulat, Entertainment aur Males ko target karna conversion rate ke liye bura tha.
help_racks_intro: Apni khud ki Hosting Building setup karna shuru hota hai Research Menu mein apne chahiye wale racks aur servers research karne se.
help_racks_setting_up_description: Racks bade containers jaise hote hain jinme multiple servers rakhe jaate hain. Racks Purchase Menu se khareede jaate hain aur bilkul office buildings ke furniture ki tarah place kiye jaate hain.
help_racks_installing_description:
Servers racks mein install hote hain. Har server kuch fixed "units" ki jagah leta hai. Har rack mein maximum kitne units ya "Us" available hain, yeh fixed hota hai.

Virtual servers ki tarah hi, server kaam kare uske pehle aapko components se use configure karna padega. Server configure hote hi woh throughput produce karna start kar dega.
help_racks_throughput_description:
Throughput teen type ka hota hai: Web, Cache aur Database. CU produce karne ke liye aapko teeno chahiye. Lagbhag hamesha ek throughput baaki se kam hoga.
    Ise hum "the bottleneck" kehte hain. Sabse kam throughput hi decide karta hai ki aapki hosting building kitna CU produce karegi.
help_racks_throughput_example: Upar wale example mein database bottleneck hai, toh produced CU badhane ke liye aur Database Servers install karne chahiye.
help_temperatures_understanding_descript:
Jaise-jaise aap rack mein aur servers add karoge, temperature dheere-dheere badhega. Aakhir mein servers bahut garam ho jayenge jisse performance par asar padega.

Servers poori building ke temperature mein contribute karte hain. Building ka temperature seedha saare racks ke temperature ko affect karta hai.
help_temperatures_servermodes_descriptio: Server modes ko server ke left side wale circle ke color se pehchana ja sakta hai. Racks ke overlays bhi aise color coded hain:
help_temperatures_servermodes_reduced_pe: Ek ya zyada servers Reduced Performance Mode mein hain.
help_temperatures_servermodes_overheat: Ek ya zyada servers Overheat Protection mein hain.
help_temperatures_servermodes_not_config: Ek ya zyada servers configured nahi hain.
help_temperatures_reduced_performance_de: Server throughput produce kar raha hai par performance kam ho gayi hai.
help_temperatures_overheat_protection_de: High temperature ki wajah se koi damage na ho, isliye server shut down ho gaya hai. Koi throughput produce nahi ho raha.
help_temperatures_overclocking_descripti:
Saare servers overclock kiye ja sakte hain. Server overclock karne ka matlab hai uska clock rate badhana. Isse server zyada throughput produce karega, par zyada power bhi use karega aur zyada heat bhi banayega.

Server overclock karne se overall temperature badhta hai, jisse us server aur doosre servers dono mein overheating issues aa sakte hain.
help_temperatures_overclocking_extended: Overclocking se heat aur temperature kam bhi kiya ja sakta hai. Clock rate ko 100% se neeche karne par server kam throughput produce karega, par kam power use karega aur kam heat banayega.
help_temperatures_overclocking_tip: Tip: Centralized Clock Rate Controller (CCC) install karke multiple servers ka clock rate ek saath control karo.
help_vc_ownership_description:
Ownership batati hai ki aapki company ka kitna hissa kiske paas hai. Investor hone ka matlab yeh nahi ki woh aapke revenue mein se cut lega. Balki, woh tab cut leta hai jab aap website bechne ka decide karte ho.
    Investors tab paisa kamate hain jab aapki valuation badhti hai.
help_vc_offers_description: Jaise-jaise aapki website ki valuation badhegi, aapko investment offers aane lagenge. Aap apni ownership ka kuch percentage dete ho, par us paise se aap company ko tezi se expand kar sakte ho.
help_vc_buyback_description: Ownership bar mein jo share chahiye uspar click karke aap apni website ke shares wapas khareed sakte ho. Price website ki current valuation se decide hota hai.
help_events_intro: Aapki website par do type ke events aa sakte hain: DDoS Attacks & Viral Boosts
help_events_ddos_description:
DDoS Attack aisa attack hai jiska target aapke servers ko overload karke aapki website ko unavailable karna hota hai.

Yeh attacks roke nahi ja sakte, par aap ensure kar sakte ho ki aapke servers itne powerful hon ki attack jhel sakein.
help_events_viral_description:
Viral boost ka matlab hai ki aapki website thode time ke liye bahut popular ho gayi hai. Is time mein aap dher saare naye users la sakte ho, bas aapke servers load jhel paayein.

Viral Boosts sirf high satisfaction rating wali websites par hi hote hain.
help_support_intro:
Jaise-jaise aapki website par zyada users aayenge, support tickets aane lagenge.

Agar tickets ignore kiye, toh aapki website ki support satisfaction kam hogi aur seedha website ki overall satisfaction rating par asar padega.
help_support_resolving_description: Tickets resolve karna start karne ke liye aapko ek Supporter hire karna padega. Naye hires automatically aapki pehli website ki pehli available team mein assign ho jayenge.
help_support_complexity_description:
Tickets 3 complexities mein aate hain: Low, Medium aur High.

Saare Supporters har type ke ticket handle kar sakte hain, par ticket jitna complex, resolve karne mein utna zyada time. Tickets 36 ghante ke andar resolve ho jane chahiye, warna woh support satisfaction kam karne lagenge.

Tip: Supporters ko apne level se match karne wale tickets par kaam karna pasand hai, warna woh naakhush hone lagte hain.
help_support_teams_description:
Apni website ke Support tab se aap apne supporters ki teams bana sakte ho. Jab Medium aur High complexity tickets aane lagein, tab yeh feature bahut important hai.

Teams setup karke aap ensure kar sakte ho ki Supporters sirf wahi tickets handle karein jo unke level aur speed se match karte hain.
help_ccc_intro: CCC (Centralized Clock Rate Controller) unit se aap multiple servers aur racks ka clock rate ek hi jagah se control kar sakte ho.
help_ccc_assign_headline: Rack ko CCC se assign karna
help_ccc_assign_description: Ek rack aur uske saare servers ko CCC se assign karne ke liye bas rack par click karo aur dropdown list se chahiye wala CCC choose karo.
help_ccc_assign_multiple_headline: Multiple racks ko CCC se assign karna
help_ccc_assign_multiple_description: Racks Menu use karke aap multiple racks ko ek hi CCC se assign kar sakte ho.
help_ccc_clockrate_description: Default clock rate decide karta hai ki jab koi rule active nahi hai tab clock rate kya hoga.
help_ccc_rules_description: CCC mein aap aise rules configure kar sakte ho jo specific events par change hote hain. Jaise, aap default clock rate 0% set kar sakte ho aur DDoS Attack hone par CCC clock rate ko 100% tak badha dega.
help_production_intro_1: Yeh employee types components aur modules produce kar sakte hain: Developers, Designers, LeadDevelopers, Marketers aur SysAdmins.
help_production_intro_2: Components aur modules se kai type ke items banaye ja sakte hain, jaise website features, servers ya marketing campaigns.
help_production_intro_3: Module bas components ka ek set hai jo merge karke ek bana diya gaya hai.
help_production_intro_4: Ek production employee ek time par sirf ek component ya module produce kar sakta hai. Production time employee ki total speed par based hai. Agar employee ko module banana hai par uski requirements inventory mein available nahi hain, toh production ruk jayega.
help_production_unlocking_headline: Aur components aur modules unlock karna
help_production_unlocking_description: Production menu sirf already researched Components aur modules dikhata hai. Aur unlock karne ke liye aapko Research Menu mein jana padega
help_production_queue_description: Production queue se aap pehle se plan kar sakte ho. Queue mein add kiye gaye components/modules employee automatically banayega. List khatam hote hi employee automatically phir se shuru kar dega.
help_production_tip: Production automate karne aur multiple employees ko manage karna aasaan banane ke liye aap Managers use kar sakte ho.
help_ceo_intro_description: Startup Company mein CEO hi akela employee type hai jiski skill change ki ja sakti hai.
help_ceo_change_description: Aap kabhi bhi apne CEO ki skill change kar sakte ho. Dhyaan dein, CEO ki current skill change karne se selected employees (manager) unassign ho jayenge, active tasks cancel ho jayenge aur saari progress chali jayegi.
help_investment_intro:
Jaise-jaise aapki company expand hogi, ek point aayega jab paisa koi problem nahi rahega.

Yahi accha time hai apni company ke alawa doosre projects mein invest karna shuru karne ka. Har investment project ek bonus unlock karta hai jo aapki company ko aur strong banata hai.
help_investment_investing_description: Har project mein ek upfront payment aur ek daily contribution dono chahiye. Di gayi limits ke andar aap decide karte ho ki roz kitna contribute karna hai.
help_investment_cancel_description:
Agar aap minimum daily contribution aur pay nahi kar paa rahe, ya project mein ab interest nahi hai, toh aap project cancel kar sakte ho. Aapki saari progress aur
invest kiya hua paisa chala jayega. Jahan chhoda tha wahan se continue nahi kar paoge. Project ko poora dobara start karna padega, upfront payment bharne ke saath.
tooltip_dismiss_cooldown: Is employee ko fire karne se pehle aapko {days} din wait karna padega.
sell_delete_website_warning: Iske liye aapko pehle apne investors ko buy out karna padega.
hrmanager_granted_raise_label: HR Manager ne {employeename} ({employeetype}) ki salary {salaryraise}/month badha di ({bonus} bonus ke saath).
allow_salary_raise: Salary raise dene ki permission do
allow_salary_raise_description: Isse HR Manager un saare employees ko automatically respond kar payega jo competitor offers ya low mood ki wajah se salary raise maang rahe hain.
retire_now_warning: Isse game khatam ho jayega aur yeh undo nahi ho sakta. Pakka abhi retire hona hai?

steam_store_page_intro: Startup Company ek business simulation sandbox game hai. Aap ek chhote startup ke CEO ho aur apni company grow karne ke liye excited ho. Thode se investment ke saath, aap ek amazing website banane nikle ho jo duniya ke sabse bade tech giants ko takkar de, is ummeed mein ki aap history ki sabse valuable company ban jao.
steam_store_page_website_description: Aapki company ki success is baat par depend karti hai ki aap website kitne acche se run aur manage karte ho. Aapko features develop aur improve karne honge, saath mein hosting capacity badhani hogi aur marketing campaigns chalane honge.
steam_store_page_office_description: City aapko har size aur shape ke offices offer karti hai. Sabse suitable kaunsa hai, yeh aap decide karo. Office ko organize aur decorate karna aapka kaam hai, aur saath mein employees ko khush bhi rakhna hai.
steam_store_page_employees_description: Aapke employees aapki success ka bahut important hissa hain. Jaise-jaise aap grow karoge, aapko aur log recruit karte rehna padega. Time ke saath, aapke employees aapse aur company se zyada demand karne lagenge. Unhe khush rakhna aapka kaam hai, isse pehle ki aapke competitors unhe aisa job offer bhej dein jo woh mana na kar sakein!
steam_store_page_servers_description: Stable aur reliable servers ke bina koi website nahi. Jaise-jaise aapki website pe traffic badhega, aapko virtual servers se apne khud ke fully featured hosting center par shift hona padega.
steam_store_page_competition_description: Goal clear hai: industry ki sabse badi website bano. Aap apne competitors ko khareed kar merge karna chahte ho ya unse aage nikal kar unka business band karwana chahte ho, yeh aap par hai!
steam_store_page_community_description:
Humein lagta hai ki ek strong community gaming experience ko aur behtar hi banati hai. Isiliye Startup Company Steam Workshop ke through poori tarah moddable hai.

Hum apni community ko Localizor ke through game translate karne mein help karne ke liye bhi invite karte hain: [url]https://www.localizor.com/game/1/translations[/url]
